provenance.by: sources/events-pt/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: Strictest of the sources: no reuse licence or terms page was found for either host. Both robots.txt files allow the paths read; agendalx.pt sets Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference. So: reference use only, name the source, link to the event, no AI training. Not reviewed by a person: whether this is enough to republish is for Dinis.

about: Events on now or starting within 60 days (to 2027-01-17) in the places listed, as schema.org Event records, each with its source URL and the time read. Dates are as the source gives them (Lisbon time; a time is added only where a single start hour is shown); a long-running event shows its first and last day. organizer is null where the source does not name an organiser (the agenda's publisher is in source). A dated record read by code, not a ticketing or booking service: check the organiser before travelling.
